# owasp-llm-checklist

> Static checklist for the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 over a repository: ten pattern hints plus answered questions, as Markdown or JSON. Python package `trysac-owasp-llm-checklist`, import name `owasp_llm_checklist`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits

## Optional

- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools used and discarded
- [Project record](docs/PROJECT.md): objective and scope
